reference: Liu et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 112501 (2016)

summary.octupole_nature: B(E1)/B(E2) is ~12 times smaller than the stable-octupole benchmark 224Th, quantitatively establishing octupole softness/vibration rather than rigid reflection-asymmetric deformation.

tri_multipolarity_dichotomy.chiral_partner: M1 dominant (E2 < 10%), verified in 74Br DSAM lifetimes and 78Br DCO/polarization.
tri_multipolarity_dichotomy.octupole_parity_partner: E1 dominant (8 strong links connecting opposite-parity Band 3 to Band 1).

summary.lifetime_status: No DSAM or RDDS lifetimes exist for 78Br; absolute matrix elements rely on unmeasured lifetime calibration, contrasting with the complete DSAM lifetime measurement in neighbor 74Br.
